source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The changed deserialize_user equality and four page-value equality calls use assert_eq! without a message. Add a nonempty expected-result message to each reviewed call so a failure identifies the expected user or page contents. The Option expect strings inside two expressions are not the assert_eq! message. Record unchanged assertions in rewritten fixtures separately; do not turn historical acceptance or a nearby test name into evidence that missing messages are preferred. This finding applies the deliberate nonempty-message rule and does not depend on the word should alone.
title: Five changed Graph value assertions omit expected-result messages
